def factor_stress_adjusted_angular_coherence(df):
    """Angular coherence of intraday returns, attenuated by accumulated overnight downside stress."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    theta = np.arctan(intraday_ret * 10)
    window = 20
    cos_mean = np.cos(theta).rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    sin_mean = np.sin(theta).rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    resultant = np.sqrt(cos_mean**2 + sin_mean**2)
    mean_theta = np.arctan2(sin_mean, cos_mean)
    direction_sign = np.sign(np.cos(mean_theta))
    overnight_stress = overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0).abs().rolling(window, min_periods=5).sum()
    stress_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + overnight_stress * 10.0)
    factor = resultant * direction_sign * stress_weight
    factor.name = "factor_stress_adjusted_angular_coherence"
    return factor
